name: The Eskdale Art Show
tagline: A Great Day Out For All The Family
description: Discover paintings, photographs, prints, jewellery, woodwork, pottery, scarves, bags, and handcrafted cards from talented local and regional artists. Enjoy delicious home-made refreshments in the heart of the Lake District's hidden gem.

venue.name: St Bega's C of E Primary School
venue.transport: Near Irton Road Railway Station on the Ravenglass & Eskdale Railway (La'al Ratty)

categories.name: Paintings
categories.description: Oils, acrylics, and watercolours capturing the Lake District landscape

categories.name: Photography
categories.description: Stunning shots of Eskdale valley and beyond

categories.name: Jewellery
categories.description: Unique handmade pieces from local artisans

categories.name: Woodwork
categories.description: Carved and turned pieces from native timber

refreshments: Delicious home-made refreshments including cakes, scones, and hot drinks — all in aid of St Bega's School.
exhibitorNote: Interested in exhibiting? Contact us by email for details.
